APPROVE
The extracted nested ternaries, the guard and the applier lambda take roughly 18 points out of `BuildPlan`, which leaves it well under 15. Behaviour is unchanged because each `foreach` iteration gets its own `method` variable, so capturing it directly matches the old `m` copy. The new helper's signature should compile, assuming `appliers` is declared as `Dictionary<Type, Func<object, object, object, object?>>` and `System.Reflection` is imported (I couldn't open the full file to check either).
